findings_raw.description: The API route does not validate the incoming request body; it only uses a type assertion which does not prevent runtime errors from invalid data.
findings_raw.remediation: Add input validation using a schema validator (e.g., zod) to ensure chatSettings and messages conform to expected structure before processing.

findings_raw.description: The API route returns a plain string with Content-Type: application/json in the no-tool-call case, while other routes return JSON objects or streams, leading to inconsistent response format.
findings_raw.remediation: Wrap the message.content in a JSON object, e.g., return new Response(JSON.stringify({ content: message.content }), { ... })

findings_raw.description: The OpenAI API request is made without setting a timeout, which could lead to indefinite hanging of the request.
findings_raw.remediation: Add a timeout parameter to the OpenAI request, e.g., by setting the timeout option in the OpenAI constructor or in the request call.
